note: Tone abnormalities including hypotonia and spastic diplegia are consistently reported as core clinical features in MAPK8IP3 cohorts.

evidence.text: Among 13 unrelated individuals with de novo MAPK8IP3 variants, 11 individuals (84.6%) presented with muscular tone abnormalities, including hypotonia in nine individuals and spasticity in four (with two showing both).

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: 11 individuals showed abnormalities of muscular tone (hypotonia in nine and spasticity in four; two individuals showed both).

evidence.text: In a cohort of 5 affected individuals, spastic diplegia was identified as a core phenotype, with infant hypotonia reported in multiple individuals.

source.title: Recurrent de novo MAPK8IP3 variants cause neurological phenotypes
source.quote: The core phenotype includes spastic diplegia, intellectual disability, cerebral atrophy, and corpus callosum hypoplasia.
